message.content:
Based on my search, here is a comprehensive overview of **BMI (Body Mass Index) standards** used worldwide:

---

## What is BMI?

BMI is a screening tool that calculates body weight relative to height using the formula:
- **BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height² (m²)**
- Or in pounds/inches: **(weight in lbs × 703) ÷ height in inches ÷ height in inches again**

---

## Standard BMI Classification (WHO/NIH/CDC - Used for White, Hispanic, and Black populations)

| Category | BMI Range (kg/m²) |
|----------|-------------------|
| Underweight | < 18.5 |
| Normal/Healthy Weight | 18.5 – 24.9 |
| Overweight | 25.0 – 29.9 |
| Obesity Class I | 30.0 – 34.9 |
| Obesity Class II | 35.0 – 39.9 |
| Obesity Class III (Severe Obesity) | ≥ 40.0 |

This is the standard classification adopted by the **WHO**, **NIH**, and **CDC** for most adult populations [1][2][5].

---

## Asian-Specific BMI Standards

Due to higher metabolic risk at lower body weights, **WHO and NIH guidelines for Asian populations** use **lower thresholds**:

| Category | BMI Range (kg/m²) |
|----------|-------------------|
| Underweight | < 18.5 |
| Normal | 18.5 – 22.9 |
| Overweight | 23.0 – 24.9 |
| Obese | ≥ 25.0 |

- Some Asian guidelines (e.g., Singapore) define **obesity as ≥ 27.5 kg/m²** [3][5][9].

---

## China's Adult BMI Standards (WS/T 428-2013)

| Category | BMI Range (kg/m²) |
|----------|-------------------|
| Underweight (体重过低) | < 18.5 |
| Normal (体重正常) | 18.5 – 23.9 |
| Overweight (超重) | 24.0 – 27.9 |
| Obese (肥胖) | ≥ 28.0 |

China also uses **waist circumference** to assess central obesity:
- **Men**: ≥ 90 cm
- **Women**: ≥ 85 cm [4][6].

---

## Special Populations

### Elderly (80+ years)
- **Recommended BMI range**: **22.0 – 26.9 kg/m²** (higher than general adults to account for age-related muscle loss and reduced mortality risk) [4][6].

### Children and Teens
- BMI is calculated the same way but interpreted using **age- and sex-specific percentiles**, not adult categories [1][5].

---

## Important Limitations of BMI

BMI is a **screening tool, not a diagnostic tool**. It does not:
- Distinguish between muscle and fat
- Account for body composition, bone density, or fat distribution
- Apply accurately to athletes, pregnant women, or those with very muscular builds [1][2][5][7].

For a more complete health assessment, BMI should be used alongside:
- **Waist circumference** (measures central/abdominal fat)
- **Body fat percentage**
- Other clinical evaluations [5][9].

---

## Clinical and Surgical BMI Thresholds

| Application | BMI Threshold |
|-------------|---------------|
| General bariatric surgery eligibility | ≥ 40, or ≥ 35 with comorbidities |
| Bariatric surgery with metabolic disease (2022 ASMBS/IFSO guidelines) | ≥ 35, or 30–34.9 with metabolic disease |
| Asian patients for metabolic surgery | > 27.5 |
| Weight-loss medications (e.g., Zepbound) | ≥ 30, or ≥ 27 with weight-related conditions [7][8][10] |

---

## Summary Table: Global BMI Standards Comparison

| Population | Underweight | Normal | Overweight | Obese |
|------------|-------------|--------|------------|-------|
| **WHO/CDC Standard** | < 18.5 | 18.5–24.9 | 25.0–29.9 | ≥ 30.0 |
| **Asian (WHO/NIH)** | < 18.5 | 18.5–22.9 | 23.0–24.9 | ≥ 25.0 |
| **China (WS/T 428-2013)** | < 18.5 | 18.5–23.9 | 24.0–27.9 | ≥ 28.0 |
| **Elderly (80+ China)** | — | 22.0–26.9 | — | — |

---

Sources:
1. https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/articles/9464-body-mass-index-bmi
2. https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/losing-weight/bmi-in-adults
3. https://www.myheart.org.sg/tools-resources/bmi-calculator/
4. http://www.nhc.gov.cn/ylyjs/s3573d/202412/4cf1905d32304c15ac3bc4446ddb83f1/files/f932c5c0004f4959b92613dd1024483c.pdf
5. https://www.uptodate.com/contents/image?imageKey=OBGYN%2F97661
6. https://www.chinacdc.cn/jkkp/mxfcrb/lnjk/202408/t20240823_295135.html
7. https://www.trimbodymd.com/faqs/zepbound-bmi-requirements/
8. https://www.boltpharmacy.co.uk/guide/low-bmi-gastric-sleeve
9. https://bmicalculatorweb.com/blog/who-new-bmi-classification-obesity-diagnosis-criteria.html
10. https://carelyclinic.com/gastric-sleeve-eligibility-criteria/
11. https://www.cdc.gov/bmi/adult-calculator/bmi-categories.html
12. https://apps.who.int/nutrition/landscape/help.aspx?menu=0&helpid=420
13. http://dayi.org.cn/qa/279026
